questions.stem: 相較於一般新聞，標題聳動的報導更容易被分享，往往幾小時內就傳遍網路。
questions.answer: Compared with ordinary news, reports with dramatic headlines are shared more easily, often spreading across the Internet within a few hours.
accepted_answers: Compared to regular news, stories with shocking headlines are more likely to be shared, often spreading all over the Internet within hours.
Compared with ordinary news, reports with sensational headlines get shared more easily, often going viral online within a few hours.

questions.stem: 培養批判性思考很重要，因為已有許多人被這類報導誤導，造成大眾恐慌。
questions.answer: It is very important to develop critical thinking, because many people have been misled by such reports, causing panic among the public.
accepted_answers: It is important to develop critical thinking skills, since many people have already been misled by such reports, causing public panic.
Developing critical thinking is very important, because many people have been misled by reports like these, leading to panic among the public.

patterns: 虛主詞 It is important to …

1.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般新聞」句首用 Compared with／to ordinary news（Compared 是過去分詞，不寫 Compare）；也可以把比較放進句子裡寫 … more easily than ordinary news。「標題聳動的報導」reports with dramatic／sensational headlines（介系詞片語後位修飾）。「更容易被分享」are shared more easily／are more likely to be shared。「往往幾小時內就傳遍網路」是前面情況的延伸，中文沒有主詞，用分詞構句 , often spreading across the Internet within a few hours。
evidence: 往往幾小時內就傳遍網路
1.strategy_zh: 句首「相較於…」→ Compared with + N, …（或 … 比較級 + than + N）；句尾沒有主詞的補充說明 → , (often) V-ing …。
hints: 切成四段：相較於一般新聞／標題聳動的報導／更容易被分享／往往幾小時內就傳遍網路
標的詞彙：compare（相較）、ordinary（一般的）、headline（標題）、share（分享）、spread（傳遍）、Internet（網路）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + are shared more easily, often V-ing … within a few hours

2.explanation_zh: 「培養批判性思考很重要」主詞是動作，用虛主詞 It is very important to develop critical thinking（或動名詞 Developing critical thinking is …）。「因為已有許多人被這類報導誤導」人是被誤導的一方，「已有」用完成式被動 many people have been misled by such reports（mislead 的 p.p. 是 misled）。「造成大眾恐慌」是前面整件事的結果，中文沒有主詞，用句尾分詞 , causing panic among the public。
2.strategy_zh: 「做某事很重要」→ It is important to VR；句尾沒有主詞的「造成…」→ , causing + N。
hints: 切成四段：培養批判性思考／很重要／因為已有許多人被這類報導誤導／造成大眾恐慌
標的詞彙：develop（培養）、critical thinking（批判性思考）、important（重要的）、mislead（誤導）、panic（恐慌）
句型框架：It is very important to VR …, because S + have been p.p. …, causing + N

traps.literal_error: …, often it spreads across the Internet in a few hours.

bonus.text: Spreading across the Internet within hours, reports with sensational headlines are shared far more easily than ordinary news.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把分詞構句移到句首 Spreading across …，比較改用 far more … than ordinary news；分詞構句的主詞要和主要子句一致（reports）。

traps.literal_error: It is very important to develop criticize thinking, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「批判性思考」是抽象名詞 critical thinking（形容詞 critical＋名詞 thinking），不要寫成動詞 criticize；也可以說 the ability to think critically。

traps.literal_error: …, many people have been misled by such reports, it caused panic among the public.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「造成大眾恐慌」前面省略了主詞（指前面整件事），英文不能用逗號接 it caused …；用句尾分詞 , causing panic among the public。

bonus.text: Had more people thought critically before believing such reports, the public panic could have been avoided.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用省略 if 的假設倒裝 Had + S + p.p.（與過去事實相反）從反面說明批判性思考的重要；假設語氣與倒裝只當加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文「培養批判性思考很重要」主詞是動作，英文用虛主詞 It is very important to develop critical thinking；「已有許多人被…誤導」用完成式被動，最後「造成大眾恐慌」沒有主詞，用句尾分詞 , causing panic among the public。

1.translation: Compared with ordinary news, reports with sensational headlines are more likely to be shared, often spreading all over the Internet within a few hours.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般新聞」用分詞片語 Compared with；「更容易被分享」用 be more likely to be shared（被動不定詞）；「往往幾小時內就傳遍網路」以分詞構句 often spreading all over the Internet 補充結果。

2.translation: It is important to develop critical thinking because many people have already been misled by such reports, causing panic among the public.
2.explanation_zh: 「培養…很重要」用虛主詞 It is important to V；「已有許多人被誤導」用現在完成式被動 have already been misled；「造成大眾恐慌」是被誤導的結果，用分詞構句 causing panic among the public（which has caused public panic 亦可）。

issues_zh: 參考譯文 [2] Developing critical thinking is very important, … 本身正確，但用的是動名詞主詞，沒有用到這一句的標的句型 NFSUBJ（虛主詞 It is important to …）；參考譯文和「標的句型都要用到」的要求不一致，第 2 部分 accepted 也收 is very important 等動名詞主詞寫法。建議把 [2] 改成 It is crucial to develop critical thinking, … 之類的虛主詞寫法。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：參考譯文 [2] Developing critical thinking is very important, … 本身正確，但用的是動名詞主詞，沒有用到這一句的標的句型 NFSUBJ（虛主詞 It is important to …）；

1.translation: Compared with ordinary news, reports with sensational headlines are more likely to be shared, often spreading across the Internet within a few hours.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般新聞」用 Compared with 分詞片語；「更容易被分享」用 be more likely to be shared；「往往幾小時內就傳遍網路」用分詞構句 often spreading ... within a few hours 補充結果。

2.translation: It is important to develop critical thinking because many people have been misled by such reports, causing public panic.
2.explanation_zh: 「培養批判性思考很重要」用虛主詞 It is important to V；「因為已有許多人被……誤導」用現在完成式被動 have been misled by；「造成大眾恐慌」用現在分詞 causing public panic 表結果。
